description.value: VPL Oakridge Branch is a public library in Vancouver's Oakridge neighbourhood operated by the Vancouver Public Library system. It is freely accessible to the public and offers Wi-Fi, making it a practical stop for touring cyclists needing internet access or a quiet place to rest. As part of a major urban library network, it is a well-established civic resource.
